description: This file defines data models and a singleton store for managing channel and service status information within a macOS application. It includes multiple Codable structs representing statuses and configurations for messaging platforms like WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Google Chat, Signal, and an internal messaging system, as well as a ChannelsStore class handling state and metadata.

classes.name: ChannelsStore
classes.description: A singleton class managing the state, configuration, and metadata for messaging channels and their statuses.

methods.name: channelMetaEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a meta entry for a specific channel ID from the current snapshot.

methods.name: resolveChannelLabel
methods.description: Resolves the display label for a channel ID, prioritizing meta label, then stored labels, then ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelDetailLabel
methods.description: Resolves the detailed label for a channel ID, with fallback to label resolution.

methods.name: resolveChannelSystemImage
methods.description: Resolves the system image name for a channel ID, with fallback to default 'message' icon.

methods.name: orderedChannelIds
methods.description: Returns an array of channel IDs ordered according to available metadata or snapshot configuration.
